date.as_written: śrīśāke 1723 || jeṣṭā(!)dhikavāre 4 ... śāke guṇe jaladair mite jyeṣṭā(!)dhike budhe tithau śaṃbhoḥ

notes: The chronogram in the verse is slightly corrupt/abbreviated ('śāke guṇe jaladair mite...'), but the numeral 1723 is explicitly stated. 'tithau śaṃbhoḥ' designates the 11th, 13th, or 14th tithi.
